title: read_board
description: Read posts from the shared swarm board or retrieve member states.

since.description: Return messages posted after this sequence number. Set to 0 to read from beginning.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return in this read.

seqs.description: Return exactly these messages by sequence number, ignoring since and limit.

channel.description: Channel to read from. '*' reads all channels. If omitted, reads channels visible to the caller.

status.description: When true, returns the status of all members (wake_mode, wait_since, last_read_seq, state) instead of messages.
